turns.prompt: Why do conflict retries spike after midnight UTC?

items.text: Every device token expires at midnight UTC, so clients reconnect at once and retry the writes they queued. I only read files; nothing changed.

items.text: goldmark-highlighting wraps chroma and plugs into goldmark as an extension.

turns.prompt: Make harbor build skip pages whose source hasn't changed since the last build

items.text: A cache file in public/ can record each page's source hash and the templates' hash; a page rebuilds when either changes.
